decisive_items: single firm, non-tender nodule was palpated on the lateral tongue
response.rationale: Multiple subcutaneous mobile nodules plus a tongue nodule strongly suggest cysticercosis, though denied pork intake is a partial contradiction. Fibromatosis is less specific; NF1 lacks typical stigmata and neurologic findings.

rejected.why: No neurofibromas stigmata (café-au-lait spots, freckling) and no neurologic symptoms; tongue nodule atypical.
Firm mobile nodules are nonspecific; no distinctive features or location to favor fibromatosis over cysticercosis.
